About this prototype

This is an early Petal & Paper prototype. It has no account system, bank connection, cloud sync, or financial institution integration. Use fictional data while testing.

Petal & Paper is the current project name.

/* v7: clean mood-only mascot system and page-specific bunny companions */ .timer-buddy{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;max-width:330px;margin:12px auto 0;padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.68);border:1px solid #f0dfe0;border-radius:16px;text-align:left}.timer-buddy-art{width:72px;height:72px;flex:none}.timer-buddy-art img,.reminder-bunny-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}.timer-buddy p{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#684b4a;font-size:14px;margin:0}.reminder-bunny{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:#f7eee6}.reminder-bunny-art{width:96px;height:96px;flex:none}.reminder-bunny h3{margin-top:0}.bunny-accessory-sticker{display:none!important}.pose-card .pose-art{height:132px;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:5px}.pose-card .bunny-art-wrap{height:100%;width:100%;max-width:118px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}.pose-card .bunny-reference-art{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center}.accessory-preview .mascot-stage{width:112px;height:132px;flex:none}.accessory-preview .bunny-accessory-sticker{display:none!important}.hero-bunny .bunny-art-wrap{padding:7px;overflow:hidden}.hero-bunny .bunny-reference-art{object-fit:contain}.mascot-stage .bunny-art-wrap{padding:3px;overflow:hidden}@media(max-width:540px){.pose-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.timer-buddy{max-width:100%}.reminder-bunny{align-items:flex-start}.reminder-bunny-art{width:76px;height:76px}.pose-card .pose-art{height:120px}}
